Subject: Approval request: global mobility quote & offer addendum — Ana Ramirez (SWE II)

Hi Lauren / Monica / Vivek,

Quick request for signoff so we can finalize Ana's offer (SWE II, expected start: 2027-07-11). Ana is relocating from Madrid and needs assistance with the following items that we typically cover on hire for her band:

- Immigration / work-permit legal fees (vendor-managed) — vendor quote attached.
- One-way flight + up to 30 nights temporary housing (short-term serviced apartment).
- Shipment allowance (sea + one small air personal items).

High-level numbers from Global Mobility LLP are in the attached quote: total estimate = EUR 13,200 (~USD 14,400) worst-case; expected on-target ~EUR 9,500. I asked them to itemize so we can cap line-items on the offer addendum. Draft addendum is attached (language for expense reimbursement + cap).

Questions for you:
1) Are these items approved for this hire and under what total cap?
2) Does finance need a PO before we issue the offer?
3) Any legal language you want added regarding visa sponsorship or repayment if candidate leaves within 6 months?

Attachments: GlobalMobility-quote_Ana_Ramirez.pdf, draft_offer_addendum_Ana_Ramirez.pdf

I recommend approving the vendor and a not-to-exceed figure of USD 15k to avoid delays while we get more precise invoicing post-accept. If approved, I will send the offer with the addendum and loop the mobility vendor to begin paperwork.

Thanks,
Aditya

Thanks Aditya — good summary. I think this is in line with what we normally approve for international mid-level ICs. Two quick asks before I sign off:

- Can we set a hard cap per line item instead of a single pooled cap? Example: flights cap = $2,000; housing cap = $6,000 (30 nights); immigration/legal = $6,000; shipment = $1,000. That keeps us from over-indexing on legal fees if housing costs spike.
- Monica — please confirm cost center and whether we need a PO before sending the offer. If PO required, we should fast-track it so candidate doesn't wait.

Vivek — please confirm if the draft addendum contains the standard repayment clause (pro-rated) and any language I should avoid for EU hires.

If those two items are fine, I approve issuing the offer contingent on PO/finance sign-off.

Lauren
VP, Engineering — Platform
